name: codex-broker
description: Delegate coding tasks to OpenAI Codex (currently GPT-5.6 Sol; model and effort defaults live in ~/.codex/config.toml) from Claude. Sync and background task tools wrapping the local Codex CLI, sandbox-capped at workspace-write.

tools.name: codex_task
tools.description: Run a short Codex coding task synchronously

tools.name: codex_start
tools.description: Start a long Codex task in the background, returns job_id

tools.name: codex_result
tools.description: Fetch the result of a background Codex job

tools.name: codex_review
tools.description: Read-only Codex code review of a directory

tools.name: git_push
tools.description: Broker-side git push (outside Codex sandbox, credentials work). Never force.

tools.name: gh_repo_create
tools.description: Create a GitHub repo from a local repository via gh CLI and push.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Broker-side stage + commit (outside the Codex sandbox)

tools.name: gh_pr_create
tools.description: Create a pull request via gh (never merges)

tools.name: gh_issue_create
tools.description: Create a GitHub issue via gh
